task.description: Apply REQ-237's PROVENANCE marker convention (lib/letflow/design/req237-zig-provenance-marking-convention.md) to every .zig-citation unit in the 13 files listed in owned_modules. Insert the marker line immediately above each citation unit per REQ-237 section 2's placement rule (one of: single citation line, paragraph, table, or the two REQ-264-established edge cases -- H1-title citation as the file's literal first line, and a heading immediately followed by a bare fenced code block treated as one unit with the marker above the fence). Additive only: no .zig path text, line number, or citation content may be removed or altered -- confirm via per-file grep -c '\.zig' before/after equality.
acceptance_criteria: All 13 files in owned_modules show a net-additive diff (git diff --stat) -- no deletions of citation content, only PROVENANCE marker insertions.

Per-file grep -c '\.zig' count is identical before and after for all 13 files (baseline from step-00: req049:9, req050:28, req051:12, req052:4, req053:2, req054:3, req057:17, req058:5, req059:9, req060:17, req061:3, req062:11, req066:21; sum 141).
No file outside the 13-file owned_modules list is touched.

Every .zig citation unit in each file carries a PROVENANCE (historical, not current decision authority): marker placed per REQ-237 section 2's rule, including the two REQ-264-established edge-case shapes where applicable.
Divergence-note text ('unlike R-Co' / 'deliberately diverges' / 'diverges from R-Co') is present and word-for-word unchanged before/after in every file that carries it.

result.summary: Applied REQ-237's PROVENANCE marker convention to all 13 files in owned_modules via 4 parallel sub-agent batches (batch 1: req049/050/051, 31 markers; batch 2: req052/053/054, 8 markers; batch 3: req057/058/059/060, 25 markers; batch 4: req061/062/066, 28 markers -- 92 total). Independently re-verified rather than trusting the sub-agent reports: git status confirms exactly these 13 files modified, nothing else in the working tree (CLAUDE.md, README.md, docs/migration/README.md, and every other lib/letflow/design/ file are untouched). git diff --stat over the 13 files shows 98 insertions / 6 deletions total, net additive -- the 6 apparent deletions (all in req062-sub-process-runtime.md) are line-rewrap of existing multi-line citation bullets to make room for an inline marker, not content loss: hand-read the full req062 diff and confirmed every removed line's text reappears verbatim on the following added line, just re-indented under the new PROVENANCE prefix. Hand-read req059 and req053 diffs directly (not summarized) -- both are pure single-line marker insertions above existing paragraph/bullet citation units, no adjacent content touched. Re-ran grep -c '\.zig' per file post-edit: 9/28/12/4/2/3/17/5/9/17/3/11/21 (sum 141) -- identical to step-00's pre-flight baseline in every file, confirming no citation was dropped or duplicated. Counted PROVENANCE marker lines added across the diff (git diff | grep -c of the marker text): 92, matching the sum of the four batch reports (31+8+25+28). Ran the divergence-note check requested: grep -rnE 'unlike R-Co|deliberately diverges|diverges from R-Co' over all 13 files, before (git show HEAD:<file>) and after (working tree) -- the single-line regex itself returns zero matches in both states because the one instance (req066-api-error-response.md, 'This diverges from R-Co.') wraps across a markdown line break in both versions; re-ran with newlines collapsed to spaces and confirmed the surrounding 80-char window of text is character-for-character identical before and after. No genuinely new citation-unit shape was found beyond the 4 documented shapes plus the 2 REQ-264 edge-case precedents (H1-title-as-first-line, heading-plus-bare-fence-as-one-unit); several files exercised the sub-bullet nested-indentation variant of the paragraph shape, handled consistently by matching the citation's own indentation level.
